source: NCBI nuccore — ON840103.1 (NRPS/PKS cluster) + MT225528.1 (AETX gene cluster, complete)
notes: Epiphyte on Hydrilla verticillata. Linked to Vacuolar Myelinopathy (VM) in bald eagles and waterfowl. Hydrilla established in parts of Great Lakes basin. 2 sequences: MT225528 is the specific AETX cluster; ON840103 is the broader NRPS/PKS region. No complete genome deposited in NCBI as of 2026-06-11 — rebuild when available.
